property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp, calling fallback with exactly 10 ether always reverts when block.timestamp is less than or equal to the stored pastBlockTime; the mutant that assigns pastBlockTime before the check can let a call succeed when block.timestamp == pastBlockTime, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change assignment to occur before the timestamp check so fallback will never revert on equal timestamps (it sets pastBlockTime first then checks), altering revert behavior for reentrancy/timing edge-cases.
